classification.difficultyReason: Represent two successive runs of repeated changes by powers, multiply their factors and interpret the overall change.

content.prompt: The number of trees on Green Plateau fell by $5\%$ every year for 10 years. Then the numbers rose by $5\%$ every year for 20 years. What was the total percentage gain or loss of trees over the 30-year period? Give your answer correct to 1 decimal place.

answer.worked:
Let the original number of trees be $N$.

$$\begin{align*}\text{Final number}&=N(0.95)^{10}(1.05)^{20}\\\text{Percentage change}&=\frac{N(0.95)^{10}(1.05)^{20}-N}{N}\times100\%\\\text{Percentage change}&=((0.95)^{10}(1.05)^{20}-1)\times100\%\\\text{Percentage change}&\approx58.9\%\end{align*}$$

The positive change is a gain.
